After commit 5623e60375599fdd65689906a16dbff08686ae82 I still see the build error for ui/qt/import_text_dialog.cpp.

Might something like the following work in the interim to get macOS Intel builds working again until a better fix is developed?

```
diff --git a/ui/qt/import_text_dialog.cpp b/ui/qt/import_text_dialog.cpp
index 74faf4f590..1ab6904a8a 100644
--- a/ui/qt/import_text_dialog.cpp
+++ b/ui/qt/import_text_dialog.cpp
@@ -618,7 +618,14 @@ void ImportTextDialog::on_timestampFormatLineEdit_textChanged(const QString &tim
             char time_str[100];
             QString timefmt = QString(time_format);
 
+#if (defined(__APPLE__) && (defined(__cplusplus) && __cplusplus < 201703L))
+            /*
+             * error: 'timespec_get' is only available on macOS 10.15 or newer
+             */
+            clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &timenow);
+#else
             timespec_get(&timenow, TIME_UTC);
+#endif
 
             /* On windows strftime/wcsftime does not support %s yet, this works on all OSs */
             timefmt.replace(QString("%s"), QString::number(timenow.tv_sec));
```

Or might a better workaround conditionally use `clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &timenow);` in both wsutil/wslog.c and ui/qt/import_text_dialog.cpp with just `#if (defined(__APPLE__)`?
